Name: Keeper's Ausbildung
Notes: AUSBILDUNG IS A TRAINING A PLAYER TAKES. Kind = ausbildung. Effect is the ordinary effects language, so count:tune_<any Tuning row>+n trains a number and unlock:x trains a thing.

Name: Long Legs
Notes: Everyone runs at a loose ball harder. The same dial the Relentless talent moves - two doors to one room is fine.

Name: Cold Nerve
Notes: A shot takes less off your keeper. NOTE the minus: an Effect may take away as well as give.

Name: The Turning Floor
Notes: A MINI-GAME AUTOMATES A BREWERY SECTION. Kind = minigame and Section names a row of BrewerySections.csv. What it gives today is a VAT - count:batches_<section>+1 - which is the foundation the played mini-game will sit on top of later.

Name: The Turning Circles
Notes: The fourth, and the one you described: circles that all have to turn the same way round. Today it buys a copper; the game goes on top.

Name: The Cellar Watch
Notes: The fifth. tools/brewery_check.gd measures this one as worth the most - one vat is 24 bottles a season, two is 48.
